notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Changes

 Added the dash mechanic and autorun option
 Enemy will be more aware of you when dashing and a bit less than before when walking, this way should be it easier to catch them by surprise
 Improved enemy behaviour after reaching chase boundaries
 Added small tutorial session in the second chapter to explain the surprise mechanic and that enemies are more aware of you while dashing
 A message now shows at the start of a fight if you catch the enemy by surprise
 Extra equipment found in the Skywatchers storyline will be kept between chapters (it was already that way for the other storylines)
 Clicking on npc/enemies with the mouse will now set the pathfinder to chase them

Fixes

 Fixed an issued that caused the foreground parallax to disappear after reloading without closing the game
 Fixed minor graphical glitches related to windows in combat
 Fixed a bug that made dead enemies give you the ambush buff for the next battleChanges
